title: CLI and Tools Overview
summary: This module encompasses all command-line interface functionalities and the extensive collection of tools available for CrewAI agents, enabling users to manage projects, interact with external services, and extend agent capabilities.

nodes.label: CLI Commands
nodes.title: CLI Commands
nodes.description: Handles all command-line interface operations for managing crews, tools, and deployments.

nodes.label: CLI Utilities
nodes.title: CLI Utilities
nodes.description: Provides foundational utilities and base classes for CLI commands, authentication, and template handling.

nodes.label: Tool Definitions
nodes.title: Tool Definitions
nodes.description: Defines the structure and behavior of various tools available within the CrewAI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Tool Adapters
nodes.title: Tool Adapters
nodes.description: Provides adapters for integrating various external tools and data sources, such as enterprise action kits, LanceDB, and RAG systems, into the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Tool Utilities
nodes.title: Tool Utilities
nodes.description: Provides utilities for managing and loading tools, including extracting tool specifications and loading various data formats for RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) purposes.

nodes.label: Core Framework
nodes.title: Core Framework
nodes.description: The central components of the CrewAI system, including agent management, LLM integration, and task/flow execution.

nodes.label: Data & Knowledge
nodes.title: Data and Knowledge Management
nodes.description: Handles data storage, retrieval, and knowledge management within the CrewAI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Utilities & Experimental
nodes.title: Utilities and Experimental Features
nodes.description: Contains general utility functions, experimental features, and development/testing tools for the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: CLI Layer
groups.title: Command Line Interface
groups.description: This group represents the user-facing command-line interface and its underlying utility functions for interacting with the CrewAI system.

groups.label: Tool Layer
groups.title: Agent Tools and Integrations
groups.description: This group defines the various tools available to agents, their integration mechanisms, and the utilities for managing them.

groups.label: Core Dependencies
groups.title: Underlying Framework and Data
groups.description: These modules provide the core AI framework, data management capabilities, and general utilities that support both the CLI and the tools.
